Title: 2026-04-09 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === General ===
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing increased Movement Speed visual effects to be created when joining a Toy Train.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing respawn timers from Level 10 to 23 to be lower than intended.

=== Battlegrounds: Blackheart's Bay ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Bombardment
    • [Undocumented] Damage increased from 2875 to 3000.

=== Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Heroes to collect more Skulls than allowed during the Objective phase on Haunted Mines.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Frostmourne Hungers [D]
    • [Undocumented] Maximum damage bonus increased from 5000 to 10000.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Arthas's Frost Presence to fire the Quest Completed notification twice.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Arthas's Frost Presence to give double Quest progress when hitting an enemy Hero with both the path and the circle.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Arthas's Rime to heal Arthas even when not Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Ghouls summoned by Arthas's Army of the Dead to have a duration instead of losing Health over time.
  • [Undocumented] The tooltip for Arthas's Frost Presence has been updated from "Root enemy Heroes" to "Hit enemy Heroes".

=== Heroes: Garrosh ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Garrosh's Wrecking Ball to show the mark on targets barely not in range.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Rock-It! Turret [Q]
    • [Undocumented] Maximum duration increased from 17 to 20 seconds.
  • Robo-Goblin [R1]
    • Damage [Undocumented] ~~per second~~ over time increased from 90 to 100.

=== Heroes: Mal'Ganis ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Necrotic Embrace [W]
    • [Undocumented] Damage increased from 110 to 121.
    • [Undocumented] Additional functionality: Now provides 15 Spell Armor for 3 seconds.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing effects related to the duration of Mal'Ganis's Necrotic Embrace to not work correctly.

=== Heroes: Medivh ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Winds of Celerity
      • [Undocumented] Movement Speed bonus increased from 75% to 100% of Raven Form's Movement Speed bonus.
    • Raven's Intellect
      • [Undocumented] Mana and Health Regeneration bonus increased from 125% to 200%.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue that caused Medivh's Guardian of Tirisfal to not increase Arcane Rift's search duration.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 16
    • Dwarf Launch
      • [Undocumented] Cooldown reduction decreased from 2 to 1 second.
  • Level 20
    • Mountain King
      • [Undocumented] Cooldown increase removed.

=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Ragnaros's Living Meteor to not deal the landing damage.

=== Heroes: Sgt. Hammer ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Maelstrom Rounds
      • [Undocumented] Damage bonus increased from 30% to 40%.
  • Level 13
    • Hyper-Cooling Engines
      • [Undocumented] Now triggers against Structures too.
      • [Undocumented] No longer grants bonuses from splash damage.
  • Level 20
    • Advanced Lava Strike
      • [Undocumented] Damage bonus increased from 50% to 65%.
    • Ultra Capacitors
      • [Undocumented] Now triggers against Structures too.
      • [Undocumented] No longer grants bonuses from splash damage.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Echo of the Elements
      • [Undocumented] Time window to gain stacks increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds.
      • [Undocumented] Extra bounces no longer deal reduced damage.
      • [Undocumented] Quest requirements increased from 20/40/100 to 20/50/125.
      • [Undocumented] Removed functionality: No longer provides an extra bounce of Chain Lightning after unlocking the second Reward.
  • Level 7
    • Rolling Thunder
      • [Undocumented] Additional functionality: Now also provides an extra bounce of Chain Lightning.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Lunar Flare [E]
    • [Undocumented] Damage bonus per stack reduced from 3.5% to 3%.
  Talents:
  • Level 13
    • Quickening Blessing
      • [Undocumented] Movement Speed bonus on Light of Elune's target increased from 20% to 25%.
  • Level 20
    • Commander of Sentinels
      • [Undocumented] Cooldown increase removed.
